Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CURRENT HANDOFF
- Last observation: Thursday 18, Spring Year 1, 2:40 pm, Research Farm crop plot south of farmhouse. Funds 402g. Farmer near plot's right side; slot 7 Mixed Seeds selected, one seed last confirmed. Bare tilled tile immediately LEFT was highlighted green, cursor (0.475,0.465). No menu open.
- LAST EXECUTED: C for 0.3s to plant that tile; completed, but NO subsequent screenshot. Seed consumption/planting NOT confirmed; no watering afterward. Do not assume slot 7 is empty.
- Thursday: harvested one parsnip, held count 11→12. Three remaining established plants received correctly located watering splashes. First of two Mixed Seeds planted in freshly harvested rightmost/southeast tile: count 2→1, highlight green→red; watering splash confirmed at 1:50 pm. Second seed planting is the pending outcome above. If successful, five occupied tiles would follow from today's count; verify visually rather than treating this as established.
- Inventory: 12 parsnips, no Parsnip Seeds, Bamboo Pole slot 6, Mixed Seeds slot 7 pending, Fiber slot 8, parsnips slot 9, Stone slot 10. Fiber last explicitly counted 32 Wednesday morning; more collected afterward, current count unknown. Two stones last inspected Tuesday; Wood and a Geode also held, current quantities/slots unclear. No parsnips sold/eaten. Watering can refilled Monday and used since; current remaining water unknown.
- New envelope seen Thursday, unread. Immediate unfinished work: confirm final planting and its watering, remaining mail, safe bedtime. Broader goals: Advancement/scarecrow, Robin's axe, Introductions, Coop. Latest intent was staying near home after repeated navigation delays.

CROPS / PROGRESSION
- Initial 15 parsnip seeds from house package. Tooltip says four days; first two planted Wed 3, harvested Sun 7. More harvested Thu 11, Sat 13, four Mon 15, two Tue 16, one Thu 18; total held now 12.
- Monday harvested four, replanted all three remaining Parsnip Seeds, leaving six occupied tiles by prior count. All six received watering animations, last two at 12:20/12:50 am. Tuesday harvested two, initially inferred four remaining, but only three sprouts located and watered. Wednesday rain, dark soil and three visible sprouts; no manual watering. Thursday four plants were individually encountered before one was harvested. Prior three-versus-four discrepancy unresolved; no demonstrated cause or crop loss.
- Thursday diagonal watering intended southwest instead poured directly south. Moving directly above crop and retargeting produced correct splash. A hand cursor on another plant did not guarantee harvest: X left plant and count unchanged; watering later succeeded.
- At Thursday 12:30 pm, C with watering can selected was followed by rightmost plant disappearing, Parsnip pickup, count 11→12. Apparently harvested rather than watered; observed exception, not a proven universal C behavior.
- Rain Thu 11/Fri 12 and Wed 17 associated with growth without manual watering; rain replacing manual watering is supported by observations, not separately tested. Earlier slow right crop due to missed watering was only a hypothesis; identifying its pale-rooted appearance as a weed was disproved by harvest.
- Getting Started completed; journal coin collected 100g (450→550). Total earnings last inspected 100g. Advancement requires Farming level 1 AND crafting a scarecrow; quest says scarecrows prevent crows eating crops. ALL five skills still level 0 on Tuesday despite 11 harvested parsnips. No later skill check or level-up screen observed. Harvest XP/threshold unknown.
- Crafting inspected Tuesday: Wood Sign costs 25 Wood (red); displayed item not consumed. Wood Fence costs 2 Wood (red). Neither is a scarecrow; scarecrow recipe unidentified, nothing crafted.
- Raising Animals requires building a Coop. Quest says Robin constructs buildings for materials/money and lives north of town; costs unknown. Robin's Lost Axe clue explicitly south of Marnie's Ranch where she cut wood; axe unfound. Earlier handoff claimed 250g reward, but latest quest view showed no reward, so not reconfirmed. Introductions last numerical check long ago 3/28; later Lewis conversations not reconciled, Willy greeting attribution uncertain. To The Beach apparently resolved after pre-5-pm Willy scene/Bamboo Pole receipt; later absent from journal.

TIME / MAIL / SLEEP
- Outside at 2:00 am Monday night: slumped on porch, woke Tuesday in bed, 495→446g. Earlier loss 550→495g. Tuesday mail explicitly confirmed Harvey exhaustion medical bills of 55g and 49g, explaining both.
- Other Tuesday letters: Evelyn says most crops are seasonal and spring crops die when summer arrives; Pierre now sells fertilizer, effects/prices unknown. All Tuesday mail cleared, envelope gone.
- Tuesday reached sleep prompt 11:50 pm and clicked Yes; Wednesday 6:00 am in bed, energy appeared full, 446g retained. Wednesday stranded by pond until 1:50 am; next observation Thursday 6:00 am at home, 446→402g. Forced return/44g medical charge likely, not yet confirmed by unread Thursday mail.
- Tiny actions/hover cycles often cost 10–30 game minutes. observation_age_limit rejections did NOT execute, although time advanced substantially. No fixed real-time conversion established. Crafting clock stayed 2:00 pm across several inspections, not proof all menus pause.

CONTROLS / TARGETING
- WASD movement, simultaneous directions diagonal. ~0.2s horizontal often one tile, 0.4s two; camera/obstacles/animation vary. Long indoor movement overshoots; tiny south taps may not turn. Retarget after camera movement.
- Slots: 1 axe, 2 Hoe, 3 Watering Can, 4 pick-shaped tool, 5 curved blade, 6 Bamboo Pole, 7 seeds when held. Numeric selection and toolbar clicking work. Separate selection/use reliable; old simultaneous 6+C failed rod selection. Movement+number sometimes works but confirm selection visually.
- C uses tool/item; hover valid tilled tile then C reliably plants. Green target valid, red after planting/occupied. Left-click alone often just targets. Harvested soil reusable without hoeing. Hoe click/C tills; avoid occupied crops.
- X interacts/harvests when adjacent and
